question: Does hermit PR #1847 take LiteInst's baseline stack self-determinism from 302/412 differing to 0/412, and with that baseline clean, is there a TSC leak into LiteInst stack memory?

repos.reverie_pin_note: IDENTICAL in both arms, so the Reverie side is not a variable in this A/B.

guests.tscleak.c: identical shape but fills the array with raw rdtsc(). Prints only a boolean. Source: scratch/w27-tsc/, authored by hermit-w27.

relaxations: none in the strict arms; the negative control deliberately relaxes --no-virtualize-time --no-virtualize-metadata and is labelled as such
